detailCrop.scope: A second genuine native 3D subfrustum render from the unchanged physical reference camera; not an upscaled screenshot.

garden.construction: Closed terrain, measured-source stone scans, separate folded leaves and supporting branch geometry; no opaque foliage pads or image replacement

independentPlanting.source: Independent Poly Haven Shrub02 and Periwinkle Plant original meshes/4K PBR maps; actual soil/island placement, no reference-scene image projection

scannedForest150.placement: Uniformly scaled original variants seated on the highest actual modeled ridge surface; no screen-facing tree planes

cameraSky.projection: world-fixed spherical cap with measured HDR outside and8percent boundary blend

skyRadiance.scope: Measured CC0 HDR lighting retained. Independent generated atmosphere/cloud-only spherical cap decoded to linear and world-oriented. Low solar disk and the actual shadow-casting directional light share the same direction; measured HDR environment is re-aligned to that direction. No reference photo projection, architecture, garden, or scene replacement plate.

connections.landingSupports: Embedded retaining courses and terrain-supported bank stairs; no mid-water piers

bridge.abutments: Weathered rock shoulders embedded in the two planted banks

layout.scope: Actual closed arched bridge in front of the main stair/landing, with jointed granite deck, compact hall stair, front-edge side connection and descending right approach; hidden depths and heights remain inferred.

castEnd.method: Closed connected six-scroll ground with rounded ribs, central boss and24cast beads; bronze retainer and narrow gilt bead
